entries.9b3273790befb2e8: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,347,125 million (¥1,347,125 million), down 3.2% from ¥1,391,480 million in the previous fiscal year. Revenue from external customers was ¥506,336 million for Semiconductor and Electronic Materials, ¥300,302 million for Crasus Chemical, ¥178,430 million for Mobility, ¥174,358 million for Chemicals, and ¥92,202 million for Innovation Materials; the 5 reportable segments total ¥1,251,628 million, and "Other" is ¥95,497 million. Only Semiconductor and Electronic Materials posted higher revenue, mainly because sales volume of back-end process materials for advanced semiconductors such as those for AI increased. Crasus Chemical posted lower revenue because of a decline in selling prices accompanying the fall in naphtha prices, and Mobility because of the impact of business transfers such as secondary battery packaging materials and food packaging materials and reduced demand from some domestic customers.
